title: Reading Pi Coding Agent: From Multi-Provider Compatibility to Structured Tool Results
excerpt: Pi implements layered architecture for model protocols, Agent orchestration, terminal interface, and CLI applications through pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui, and pi-coding-agent. For multi-provider support, Pi uses compatible configurations to unify OpenAI-compatible API fields, reasoning, and usage differences; token counting relies on data actually returned by the provider, so only best effort can be achieved. When switching across providers, Pi preserves or downgrade-converts contexts like reasoning, but cannot guarantee lossless migration of private signatures and ultra-long contexts. Additionally, Pi supports end-to-end cancellation of streaming requests and distinguishes between model-visible content and UI-specific data through structured tool results, thereby maintaining the Agent core's transparency, simplicity, and extensibility.
